title: The security report shows examples, not every bug
myth: A failed security review lists every bug, so fixing those exact lines is enough.

beats.say: Dex's failed security review lists three bugs. He'll fix exactly those lines.
Archie: the report shows examples of each issue class, not every instance.
beats.speaker: archie

beats.say: So find that pattern everywhere, and fix it all.
Every paid resubmission costs nine hundred ninety-nine dollars again.
Dex goes bug hunting. The whole forest.

facts.claim: The security review report gives examples of each issue class rather than every instance.
facts.evidence: the report gives examples of each issue class rather than every instance

facts.claim: A failed report means finding and fixing the pattern everywhere.
facts.evidence: find and fix this pattern everywhere

facts.claim: The fee is $999 per paid solution.
facts.evidence: a fee of $999 per paid solution

facts.claim: The fee is charged again on every resubmission after a failed attempt.
facts.evidence: again on every resubmission after a failed attempt
